metadata.title: Raw Server Error Messages Exposed to Console and DOM — Server Topology Disclosure

sources: ApplinX REST API HttpErrorResponse.error.message (may contain internal server details)
transformations: No sanitization or mapping to generic messages
this.errorMessage = msg (DOM binding — HTML encoded by Angular {{ }}, XSS-safe)
console.error(msg) (no sanitization — raw error to browser console)
sinks: Browser console (console.error) — accessible to DevTools and XSS post-exploitation
DOM {{ errorMessage }} binding — HTML encoded (info disclosure only, XSS-safe)

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Server topology information (internal IPs, connection strings, error patterns)

impact.description: Server internal details exposed to browser console. DOM binding uses Angular {{ }} interpolation — XSS-safe, info disclosure only. Post-XSS amplification: harvested server details enable targeted reconnaissance. Scanner's 'innerHTML' XSS claim is FALSE POSITIVE — Angular template encoding is applied.

prerequisites: Authenticated user session, browser DevTools access
For post-XSS collection: prior XSS exploitation (VULN-004)

compensating_controls: Angular {{ }} template binding HTML-encodes DOM output — no XSS risk from error messages

remediation.fix_approach: Map ApplinX error messages to generic user-friendly strings in handleError(). Remove or gate console.error() and console.log() debug calls behind !environment.production. DOM {{ errorMessage }} is XSS-safe but should show generic text.

history.note: Raw server error messages console.error()'d and DOM-bound in webLogin; MacroComponent logs macro names and API responses

Confirmed info disclosure via console.error(). DOM binding is XSS-safe (Angular {{ }} encoding) — Scanner's innerHTML XSS claim is a false positive. CVSS MEDIUM 4.3 reflecting info disclosure to authenticated users.
